{{Quote|They took it upon themselves to make a ''record'' of Jedi history and teachings&hellip;|Palpatine, to Leia Organa Solo, on the actions of a group of Jedi around this year|<ref name="DE">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''600 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. The era, having begun [[1000 BBY/Legends|four hundred years earlier]], featured widespread settlement into the unexplored regions of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the opening of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Around this year, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bodo Baas]] inherited the [[Tedryn Holocron]], a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi holocron]].

==Proem==
After a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of conflict between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the [[New Sith Wars]] came to an end in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] narrowly escaped destruction, and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] announced the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], reorganizing the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and codifying the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a branch of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="ATLAS">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==The galaxy in 600 BBY==
By 600 BBY, the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that followed the Ruusan Reformation, was nearly four hundred years in the making. The Republic continued its expansion into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and uncharted [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] areas that later became part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="ATLAS" />

Around 600 BBY, the Jedi [[Bodo Baas]] was one of a group of Jedi who lived and served in the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]] and who took it upon themselves to create records of Jedi history and teachings for future Jedi to learn from.<ref name="DE" /> After being promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]],<ref name="EGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Baas inherited a Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and teaching device, the [[Tedryn Holocron]].<ref name="jvs" />

[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] was born.<ref name="Ultimate Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>

==Impact==
The Great Peace of the Republic continued for nearly [[22 BBY/Legends|six hundred more years]], as the Republic continued to expand. [[Galactic economy|Economic forces]] began to shape the Republic, as companies bought [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] and established the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Bodo Baas added to the holocron the prophecy that had been written by his [[Bodo Baas's Master|own Master]] [[990 BBY|four hundred years earlier]].<ref name="jvs" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="jvs" /> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] took the Tedryn Holocron from<ref name="DE" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="jvs" /> [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="DE" /> Solo fulfilled the prophecy of Baas's Master when she and her brother, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|defeated]] Sidious.<ref name="DE6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref>

==Notable events==
*After becoming a Jedi Master, Bodo Baas inherited the Tedryn Holocron. {{Circa}}<ref name="jvs" />
*The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Allya/Legends|Allya]] was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="jvs" />
*[[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] nobles began [[Terraforming/Legends|altering]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] to suit their [[Mining/Legends|mining]] ambitions.<ref name="ATLAS" />
